name: development-flow
displayName: Development Flow — Rebuild & Redeploy Before Retest
description: Mandatory directive: after changing shared/infrastructure components (platform, connector, CLI, engine), rebuild and redeploy the affected artifacts before asking the user to test. Covers Go binaries, CLI tools consumed by VS Code/TUI, shared libraries, and the complete testing protocol — rebuild → redeploy → kill running process → retest signal. A code edit without redeploy is not yet testable.
author: RiseGen AI (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Read at the START of any session that makes changes across repositories or to shared/infrastructure components (platform, connector, CLI, engine). After every change that modifies an artifact consumed by another component, ensure the rebuild-and-redeploy sequence runs before the 'ready to test' signal. The skill is mandatory — a skip is a defect.
usage.engineers: The rebuild-and-redeploy protocol for Go binaries, CLI tools, shared libraries, and cross-repo changes.
usage.founders: The standing directive that forces agents to redeploy changed artifacts before asking for retest, closing the feedback loop and saving iterative cycles.
